title: docs(capabilities): `capabilities/approvals.mdx` says no Console field or auth admin endpoint sets `sys_user.manager_id`; `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` and the Set Manager row action do
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): a published docs page states a product fact that is false. reach: the docs site page `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx`. Filed by the `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `marchtian` · `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ`, from the dev's out-of-scope finding on #22584 (report `6096192020`, PR #22657). That PR's file surface is `automation/approvals.mdx` only, and this is a different defect class, so it was not edited there. **Reader:** triage, then the lane that owns `content/docs/**`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The sentence

`content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx`, the warn callout (about `:15`–`:20` on `origin/main`):

> it resolves `sys_user.manager_id`, and no Console field, data-API write or auth admin endpoint sets that column. Your own provisioning fills it — a seed or other system-context write, or a SCIM / directory-sync path your deployment supplies.

## What the product has (read on `origin/main`)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` declares the row action `set_user_manager` (about `:372`), whose target is `/api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (about `:378`). The implementation is `plugin-auth/src/admin-set-user-manager.ts`, which the same file names.
- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` documents `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (about `:82`) and the Setup → Users → … → Set Manager path.

So the capabilities page tells an admin that the product cannot set a manager, while the automation page tells them how to. This is the same family as the manager_id "no product surface writes it" sentences that PR #22625 fixed on `automation/approvals.mdx`, left over on a second page.

## Done when

- The callout names the Set Manager action and the admin endpoint as the in-product way to fill `manager_id`, keeping provisioning (seed, SCIM or directory sync) as the bulk path.
- It points to `automation/approvals.mdx` for the details, as it does now.
- If the "until it is filled … the request waits" clause is kept, it matches the runtime on `main`: a `manager` entry that resolves to nobody adds no slot, and the node's `onEmptyApprovers` policy decides an empty slate (default `admin_rescue`). `automation/approvals.mdx` states this once PR #22657 lands.
- A grep for the old phrase ("no Console field, data-API write or auth admin endpoint") over `content/docs` and `skills/` is in the PR body.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack manager_id set-user-manager` → 1 hit, #10153 (closed, the manager approver's organization screen), which is not this sentence. Dedupe words: capabilities approvals manager_id set-user-manager · no Console field writes manager_id docs.
